solutions.title: Technology that turns into results.

approach.title: From strategy to results, in four moves.
approach.sub: We don't just ship software. We pair technology with consulting so change actually happens — and sticks.
approach.s1Text: We map processes, people and data to find where the biggest gains are and which metrics truly matter.
approach.s2Text: We define the right mix of solutions, goals and KPIs for your context — no generic packages.
approach.s3Text: We go live with integration into your systems, team enablement and change management.
approach.s4Text: We track the metrics and evolve with you. Performance isn't a project — it's a routine.

spot.title: Train for what's dangerous, rare or costly — risk-free.
spot.text: Simulators, virtual and augmented reality turn complex training into safe, hands-on experiences. Ideal for DICE content, where making mistakes in the real world is not an option.

faq.title: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.sub: Didn't find your question? Get in touch — we reply fast.
faq.a1: Yes. All platforms are modular: you can start with a single solution and add others as needed, taking advantage of how they integrate.
faq.q2: How long does a rollout take?
faq.a2: It depends on scope. After the diagnosis we present a timeline with clear milestones. SaaS solutions can go live within weeks; larger transformation projects run in waves, delivering value from the very first release.
faq.q3: Do the platforms integrate with the systems we already use?
faq.a3: Yes. Our solutions are designed to connect to corporate systems such as ERP, HR and LMS. Integration scope is defined with your team during the diagnosis phase.
faq.q4: Which industries and company sizes do you serve?
faq.a4: We serve mid-sized and large organizations in industries such as manufacturing, mining, food, pharmaceuticals, retail and financial services.
faq.q5: How is my company's data protected?
faq.a5: Our solutions run on enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure and follow data protection principles (including Brazil's LGPD), with role-based access control and full traceability.

solutionItems.name: Paths to Growth
solutionItems.text: A modular SaaS platform that brings visibility, control and efficiency to every stage of development — from training to each employee's professional growth.

solutionItems.name: Comprova+
solutionItems.text: Build custom questionnaires and get accurate analytical reports to make talent decisions, map gaps and plan succession for key positions.

solutionItems.name: HR Retention Machine
solutionItems.kicker: AI to prevent and reduce turnover
solutionItems.text: Artificial intelligence and data science to spot attrition risks, predict turnover patterns and guide retention actions before talent walks out the door.

solutionItems.name: Strengths-Based Management
solutionItems.kicker: High performance built on people's best
solutionItems.text: A management and leadership model combining next-generation psychometrics, artificial intelligence and the Big Five model to map personality, talents and skills.

solutionItems.name: TD Planner
solutionItems.text: Automates the full cycle of training planning, delivery and certification, cutting operating costs with centralized, agile and efficient management.

solutionItems.name: E-learning Content Factory
solutionItems.text: A complete structure to turn training into digital experiences, with instructional design, multimedia and integration with your systems — the right knowledge, to the right people, at the right time.

solutionItems.name: Immersive Learn
solutionItems.kicker: Virtual reality, augmented reality and simulators
solutionItems.text: Turn complex training into immersive, interactive experiences — ideal for content that is dangerous, rare, costly or impossible to replicate in the real world.

solutionItems.name: Data-Driven Management
solutionItems.text: We build a data-driven management culture: data integration, data lake, KPI definition, analytics training and Business Decision Rooms with interactive dashboards.

solutionItems.name: Intelligent Asset Management
solutionItems.text: Monitor and optimize asset lifecycles with real-time telemetry, BI and AI agents — lower costs, higher availability and greater resale value.

solutionItems.name: Process Performance Tools
solutionItems.text: A digital and consulting solution that transforms maintenance and operations with excellence models, structured inspections and intelligent monitoring.
